TAROO: CREATIVE GAMES FOR KIDS AGES 6–10

Taroo is a creative learning app where kids don't just play games. They draw, write stories, make music, observe the world, solve creative challenges, and express their own ideas.

Through short, playful activities, kids practice creativity and communication while making something of their own.

DRAW, WRITE, TELL STORIES & MAKE MUSIC

Taroo brings different creative skills together in one kid-friendly app.

Kids can:

• Draw pictures and complete creative art challenges
• Write stories, captions, and imaginative responses
• Practice storytelling and expressing ideas
• Make rhythms and experiment with music
• Explore observation, imagination, and creative problem-solving

Every activity is designed to feel like a game while encouraging kids to think, make, and experiment.

LEARNING THAT FEELS LIKE PLAY

Taroo helps kids practice skills that are difficult to build through worksheets and multiple-choice questions.

Activities encourage kids to:

• Develop stronger writing and vocabulary
• Become more confident expressing ideas
• Practice drawing and visual thinking
• Strengthen observation and attention to detail
• Explore imagination and creative problem-solving
• Keep improving an idea instead of stopping at the first answer

There are no single “right answers.” Kids are encouraged to explore different possibilities and create in their own way.

SHORT CREATIVE GAMES KIDS CAN PLAY INDEPENDENTLY

Taroo includes a growing collection of creative games and challenges.

In Doodle Master, kids draw from prompts and references.

In Pass the Pen, kids build stories together through writing.

In Rhythm Pad, kids experiment with beats and music.

In Snap Trail, kids use observation and curiosity to explore the world around them.

Different games exercise different skills, so kids can move naturally between drawing, writing, storytelling, music, observation, and imagination.

### GENTLE AI GUIDANCE

Creating is easier when someone helps you get started.

Taroo uses AI to provide age-appropriate prompts, encouragement, and feedback that help kids develop their ideas.

The goal isn't to grade creativity or tell children what to make. Instead, Taroo encourages them to add detail, try another approach, and keep creating.

No tests. No pressure. No “wrong” creative answers.

### SEE WHAT YOUR CHILD CREATES

Progress in Taroo isn't only about points or levels.

Kids create real things: drawings, stories, writing, music, and other creative projects they can look back on and feel proud of.

Parents can also stay connected to what their child is exploring and creating.

MADE FOR KIDS AND FAMILIES

• Kid-friendly, calm design
• No ads
• No social media or open chat
• Creative activities designed for independent play
• Parent controls and visibility into activity
• A cozy alternative to passive entertainment

TURN PLAYTIME INTO CREATIVE TIME

A tablet can be more than something kids watch or tap through.

With Taroo, kids can use it to draw, imagine, write, make music, tell stories, and create.

Download Taroo and start creating today.
